parsed.internal_thinking: Charlie has wood and is refusing to trade it to me, likely to stay in Alice's good graces or because he needs it for his own expansion to node 7. My trade offer of 3 wheat for 1 wood was generous but still rejected. I have 3 wheat and 1 sheep. I cannot build anything or buy a development card. Since Charlie is being stubborn and Alice is hostile, I have no viable trades left this turn. I will end my turn and hope for a Brick 10 or Ore 5/2 roll to change my options. My long-term goal remains reaching the Wheat port at Node 3 via the road starting at 12-11.
parsed.note_to_self: Charlie rejected a 3:1 wheat-for-wood trade. He is definitely prioritizing his alliance with Alice or his own path to the Brick port. I need to find another way to get wood/brick.
parsed.say_outloud: Hard to compete with a 'heart's desire,' Charlie. I thought three-for-one would be enough to change your mind, but I respect the commitment to the project. Good luck with it.
